rows.title: account tiering standard handling procedure
rows.body: [SUPERSEDED 2025] account tiering standard records verified in status "active" must be moved to status "pending". This document may be outdated.

rows.title: account tiering standard handling procedure (rev. 2)
rows.body: [CURRENT — effective 2026-06-01, supersedes all prior versions] For account tiering standard records verified in status "active": if the record's created_at is "2024-04-04", move it to status "inactive"; otherwise move it to status "pending". Apply exactly one transition.

rows.title: account tiering standard handling procedure
rows.body: [SUPERSEDED 2025] account tiering standard records verified in status "inactive" must be moved to status "active". This document may be outdated.

rows.title: account tiering standard handling procedure (rev. 2)
rows.body: [CURRENT — effective 2026-06-01, supersedes all prior versions] For account tiering standard records verified in status "inactive": if the record's created_at is "2025-11-14", move it to status "pending"; otherwise move it to status "active". Apply exactly one transition.
